ddl.value: ("purpose" = 'sign-in' and "user_id" is null) or ("purpose" = 'link' and "user_id" is not null)
ddl.name: contact_codes_purpose_consistent

ddl.value: ("operation" = 'publish-template') = ("template_ref" is not null) and ("operation" = 'publish-template') = ("game_id" is null)
ddl.name: game_admin_steps_subject_coherent

ddl.value: ("contract_family" is null) = ("contract_id" is null) and ("operation" in ('define-milestone', 'set-claims-paused')) = ("contract_id" is not null)
ddl.name: game_admin_steps_contract_coherent

ddl.value: char_length("unsigned_payload") <= 520000 and ("signed_payload" is null or char_length("signed_payload") <= 520000)
ddl.name: game_admin_steps_payload_bounded

ddl.value: char_length("unsigned_payload") <= 65536 and ("signed_payload" is null or char_length("signed_payload") <= 65536)
ddl.name: game_milestone_claims_payload_bounded

ddl.value: ("state" = 'submitted') = ("verdict" is not null) and ("state" = 'submitted') = ("submitted_at" is not null)
ddl.name: game_runs_submitted_coherent

ddl.value: "score" is null or ("verdict" is not distinct from 'verified' and "score" >= 0)
ddl.name: game_runs_score_coherent

ddl.value:
("kind" = 'milestones' and "game_id" is null and "milestone_id" is null and "score" is null and "verification" is null)
        or ("kind" = 'milestone' and "game_id" is not null and "milestone_id" is not null and "score" is null and "verification" in ('replay-verified', 'self-reported'))
        or ("kind" = 'score' and "game_id" is not null and "milestone_id" is null and "score" >= 0 and "verification" = 'self-reported')
ddl.name: game_shares_shape

ddl.value: ("status" = 'delivering') = ("lease_id" is not null and "lease_expires_at" is not null)

ddl.value:
(
    "processing_state"::text = 'pending-validation'
    AND "validation_completed_at" IS NULL
    AND "validator_version" IS NULL
    AND "validated_entity_tag" IS NULL
    AND "content_sha256" IS NULL
    AND "detected_content_type" IS NULL
    AND "width_pixels" IS NULL
    AND "height_pixels" IS NULL
    AND "rejection_reason" IS NULL
    AND "processing_completed_at" IS NULL
  ) OR (
    "processing_state"::text = 'rejected'
    AND "validation_completed_at" IS NOT NULL
    AND "validator_version" IS NOT NULL
    AND length(btrim("validator_version")) > 0
    AND "rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL
    AND "validated_entity_tag" IS NULL
    AND "content_sha256" IS NULL
    AND "detected_content_type" IS NULL
    AND "width_pixels" IS NULL
    AND "height_pixels" IS NULL
    AND "processing_completed_at" IS NULL
  ) OR (
    "processing_state"::text = 'validated'
    AND "validation_completed_at" IS NOT NULL
    AND "validator_version" IS NOT NULL
    AND length(btrim("validator_version")) > 0
    AND "validated_entity_tag" IS NOT NULL
    AND length(btrim("validated_entity_tag")) > 0
    AND "content_sha256" IS NOT NULL
    AND "content_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "detected_content_type" IS NOT NULL
    AND "width_pixels" IS NOT NULL
    AND "width_pixels" > 0
    AND "height_pixels" IS NOT NULL
    AND "height_pixels" > 0
    AND "rejection_reason" IS NULL
    AND "processing_completed_at" IS NULL
  ) OR (
    "processing_state"::text = 'processed'
    AND "validation_completed_at" IS NOT NULL
    AND "validator_version" IS NOT NULL
    AND length(btrim("validator_version")) > 0
    AND "validated_entity_tag" IS NOT NULL
    AND length(btrim("validated_entity_tag")) > 0
    AND "content_sha256" IS NOT NULL
    AND "content_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "detected_content_type" IS NOT NULL
    AND "width_pixels" IS NOT NULL
    AND "width_pixels" > 0
    AND "height_pixels" IS NOT NULL
    AND "height_pixels" > 0
    AND "rejection_reason" IS NULL
    AND "processing_completed_at" IS NOT NULL
  ) OR (
    "processing_state"::text = 'unprocessable'
    AND "validation_completed_at" IS NOT NULL
    AND "validator_version" IS NOT NULL
    AND length(btrim("validator_version")) > 0
    AND "validated_entity_tag" IS NOT NULL
    AND length(btrim("validated_entity_tag")) > 0
    AND "content_sha256" IS NOT NULL
    AND "content_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND "detected_content_type" IS NOT NULL
    AND "width_pixels" IS NOT NULL
    AND "width_pixels" > 0
    AND "height_pixels" IS NOT NULL
    AND "height_pixels" > 0
    AND "rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL
    AND "processing_completed_at" IS NOT NULL
  )
ddl.name: assets_validation_coherent
